info.title: Shukka API
info.description: Operations an API key (or panel session) can call under `/api/v1/apps/{appSlug}`, the upload protocol, and the public no-auth feed. Session-only admin operations (delete the app, API key lifecycle, instance-level routes under `/api/admin`) are not documented here.

tags.name: Versions
tags.description: Delete a version; read its notes and trend; download an artifact.

tags.name: Notes
tags.description: Per-version release notes (editor) and public read.

tags.name: Upload
tags.description: Presigned direct upload; defaults to draft.

tags.name: Feed
tags.description: Public update feed (Electron yml or Tauri JSON) — no auth.

get.description: App detail including channels, versions, and keys.

keys.description: Present only for session actors; omitted when authenticated with an API key.

patch.description: Probes S3. API keys may only change `name`. Slug and storage fields are session-only; resubmitting unchanged values is allowed. Changing endpoint/bucket/prefix with existing artifacts probes the newest object at the new location.
Promote a draft (`currentVersion`) or roll back to a released version.

currentVersion.description: Version string, or null to clear current

delete.description: Deletes the channel and its objects.
Deletes the version and its objects.

get.description: Presigned GET for one artifact on that version (drafts included). Does not increment hits.

Read custom metadata for an exact version. Released versions are public; drafts require a session or bound app key. Explicit Authorization is validated (401/403). Returns no-store and does not increment update checks. Independent of release log.

metadata.description: Custom JSON object; at most 16 KiB of compact UTF-8 JSON. Public after release.

put.description: Replace the whole metadata object (16 KiB UTF-8 JSON); {} clears it. Last write wins.

post.description: Start a pending upload. Electron requires at least one `.yml`; Tauri requires `latest.json` and/or artifact+`.sig` pairs; Sparkle requires `appcast.xml` and/or archive+`.sig` (see spec).
Creates a version. Default is draft; `release: true` goes live.
